Small example dataset

Source: R/example_data.R
scrt_example_data.Rd

Loads the example shipped with the package: chromosomes 1 to 19 of 40 cells (12 G1 and 28 S-phase) of one mouse ESC 10x multiome sample (scRT1, mm10, 20 kb bins). It is meant for examples, the vignette and tests, not for biological conclusions. The script that built it is data-raw/make_example_data.R in the package sources.

Usage

scrt_example_data()

Value

A list with

bins

GRanges of the 123,148 20 kb bins of chr1-chr19 with gc_frequency, mappability and is_mappable.

bin_counts

Integer matrix of raw read counts, bins by cells.

g1_windows

GRanges of the 101,297 variable-width G1 windows of chr1-chr19 (about 200 G1 reads each) as produced by define_G1_windows().

window_counts

Integer matrix of raw read counts, G1 windows by cells.

rep_states

Integer matrix of replication states from the original analysis (2 = unreplicated, 4 = replicated, NA = no call), bins by the 28 S-phase cells.

rna_counts

Sparse matrix of RNA counts of the 24,860 chr1-chr19 genes, genes by cells. Use meta$nCount_rna as the library size: these columns hold only the chr1-chr19 genes (about 87% of the counts).

genes

data.frame with gene, chr, start, end, strand.

meta

data.frame of cell metadata (row names = cell IDs): is_G1, rep_percent (genome-wide fraction replicated), coverage, mapd, RNA depth and QC flags.

info

Sample, chromosomes, genome, bin width and creation date.

Examples

ex <- scrt_example_data()
dim(ex$bin_counts)
#> [1] 123148     40
table(ex$meta$is_G1)
#> 
#> FALSE  TRUE 
#>    28    12
